coordinate_space: local paper-derived metres, NOT project ENU and NOT WGS84

scale_bar.note: Endpoint picks from actual horizontal graphic scale; nominal printed scale 1 inch = 300 ft. The slight scan tilt is retained.

north_orientation.note: Printed true-meridian line, not a modern street grid. Physical sheet deformation and survey convention remain uncertain.

origin.note: Centre of circular tower symbol inside pier enclosure. Relative metre origin only.

historic_coordinate_candidate.note: The 1872 trigonometrical map prints this historic iron lighthouse position. Identification across 1869/1872 is plausible, but the historical astronomical/geodetic datum has not been converted to WGS84. Do not treat it as a validated absolute anchor.

modern_control_candidates.note: Ontario/Ohio/Grand at St Clair are modern candidate nodes; nearly collinear and outside or partly outside the 1869 sheet. The modern Illinois node is rejected because it connects to a tunnel at layer=-1. Historic street identification and changes in width must be established before use.

prohibitions: Do not report the local trace tolerance as geographic accuracy.
Do not assign zero residual merely because printed scale, meridian and one origin define a frame.
Do not label 1869 observations as measured October 1871 coast.
